title: The Tough meat in the pot
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：tough　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tough 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the father wrote of ① a tough meat in the pot in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② tougher than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the tough ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the toughest meat in the pot anybody in the house had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1987 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too tough to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the tough ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a tough winter for the village, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as tough as the winter for the village they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was tough or not, and he said so.

By 2000 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something tough, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite tough; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the tough ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2003, year after year, she wrote of another tough meat in the pot in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ tougher than anybody had expected. ⑩ The toughest winter for the village in the whole house, she said in 2005, was the one she could never quite name; the tough ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 坚韧（前置定语 a tough meat in the pot：1993 年父亲在家书里记下的那件坚韧的肉）
B. adj. 坚韧／艰难（比较级 tougher than：文中两处，一处比锅里嚼不烂的肉，一处比预想）
C. adj. 坚韧／艰难（最高级 the toughest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 坚韧（表语 too tough to do：母亲觉得它太坚韧，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 艰难（前置定语 a tough winter for the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩艰难的冬天）
F. adj. 艰难（同级比较 as tough as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里难熬的冬天相比）
G. adj. 艰难（后置定语 something tough：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 艰难（受程度副词修饰 quite tough：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: a tough meat in the pot
the toughest meat in the pot anybody
a tough winter for the village
The toughest winter for the village in

answers.why: tough 意为“坚韧”，1993 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件坚韧的肉”，此处作前置定语 a tough meat in the pot。
tough 意为“坚韧”，此处用比较级 tougher than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
tough 意为“坚韧”，家书上 九月 那行字说它是老屋里最坚韧的一件，故用最高级 the toughest meat in the pot。
tough 意为“坚韧”，母亲认为这件东西“太坚韧了，谁也用不上”，too tough to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
tough 意为“艰难”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩艰难的冬天”，此处作前置定语 a tough winter for the village。
tough 意为“艰难”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里难熬的冬天一样艰难”，同级比较用 as tough as。
tough 意为“艰难”，家书上那半行字要的是“艰难的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something tough。
tough 意为“艰难”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当艰难”，quite 修饰原级 tough。
tough 意为“艰难”，2003 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要艰难”，故用比较级 tougher than。
tough 意为“艰难”，母亲 2005 年说的是“整个老屋里最艰难的那一桩”，故用最高级 the toughest winter for the village。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件坚韧的肉。（a tough meat in the pot）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更坚韧。（tougher than …）
母亲觉得它太坚韧，谁也用不上。（too tough to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩艰难的冬天。（a tough winter for the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里难熬的冬天一样艰难。（as tough as …）
到了 2000 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件艰难的东西。（something tough）
answers: In 1993 the father wrote of a tough meat in the pot in the letter.
Everybody said it was tougher than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too tough to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a tough winter for the village.
He said nobody would call it as tough as the winter for the village they had once had.
By 2000 the letter asked for nothing but something tough.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 tough 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the father wrote of a tough meat in the pot in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the toughest meat in the pot in the house, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too tough to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a tough winter for the village, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite tough, and everybody laughed.
The tough ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
